products.product_description: Great Value Hawaiian Roll 4pk, Item # F63384. Product is perishable dinner roll ready to eat, sold in a corrugated case of 18 packages (4.5oz net wt.) individually wrapped in laminated film. This product was never sold in stores and was never available for consumer purchase. All affected product remained at wholesale distribution centers and has been accounted for.
products.reason_for_recall: Firm observed oily and sticky substance on direct food contact surface packaging of finished product.
